footer: Pairing starts on the Machine with veeloe pair; then scan or paste its link in this app.

info.footer: The Runtime reports this each time it connects to the Hub.

agentsTab.create: Create an Agent on this Machine
agentsTab.footer: The figure on the right is each Agent's Budget today. An Agent stays on one Machine and reaches only that Machine's files and tools (ADR 0002).
agentsTab.footerMany: Agents that need you always come first. The first {{count}} are shown; see the rest on the all-Agents page.

provider.footer: The key is sealed to this Machine before it is sent and stays on it alone. You can also set it on the Machine with veeloe provider add (ADR 0042).
provider.none: This Machine has no Provider yet
provider.name: Provider name
provider.failedBody: The Machine did not accept the key or its URL.

egress.footer: Data can still leave to the domains listed, so add only ones you trust. While working, an Agent can ask for a new domain through an Approval (ADR 0008).

none.title: No domains allowed
none.detail: Agents can't reach the internet at all
none.detailOne: This Agent can't reach the internet at all

offline.title: Machine offline
offline.body: {{machine}} has to be online first, so its Runtime can check the signature on this change.

invalid.title: Not a valid domain
invalid.body: Enter a domain name only, such as github.com or *.npmjs.org, without https:// or a path.

egress.top: Only the domains on this list are open to {{who}}; the sandbox shuts out everything else.
egress.topOne: Only the domains on this list are open to {{who}}, and the other Agents are untouched. The sandbox shuts out everything else.
